html:
Rastafari is a religion that began in Jamaica in the 1930s. Its followers see Haile Selassie, emperor of Ethiopia from 1930 to 1974, as God come to earth, and Africa, especially Ethiopia, as the promised land.

It grew among poor Black Jamaicans. The activist Marcus Garvey had told them to look to Africa and to be proud of being Black. When Ras Tafari Makonnen was crowned emperor of the Ethiopian Empire in 1930, some saw a prophecy fulfilled. Preachers such as Leonard Howell spread the new faith, and the colonial authorities harassed it.

  • Western society and its power are called "Babylon"; Africa is "Zion".
  • Many wear dreadlocks, keep a plant based "ital" diet, and smoke cannabis as a sacrament.
  • There is no single church; it is a loose movement of groups and "houses".

Haile Selassie's visit to Jamaica in 1966 drew huge crowds. In the 1970s the music of Bob Marley and reggae carried Rastafari worldwide, and it became part of the wider Pan African story.
